findings.statement: REQ-KRN-033 embeds the unchanged pack skill text (SKILL.md: MUST NOT create files; guard forbids any edit) next to the new order to Write the envelope file to the OS temp dir; proposal keeps pack core-sdd unchanged, so the generated agent gets contradictory instructions.
findings.recommendation: Amend the pack skill (bump) to allow only the envelope file in the temp dir, or state that the generated order overrides it; assert in SCN-KRN-139.

findings.statement: REQ-VER-002 counts failures/errors/skipped per child independently, design s.2 takes one child by priority; a testcase with several (node:test failing todo = skipped+failure, pytest failure+teardown error) gets different metrics and status.
findings.recommendation: Define one rule (exclusive with explicit priority, or independent) incl. todo, and add a scenario.

findings.statement: REQ-ENF-004 takes the project and active Run from event cwd; a reviewer whose cwd is another checkout (worktree flow) sees no review Run, so Write anywhere is allowed and the temp-only rule (ADR-0042 p.4) does not hold.
findings.recommendation: State the assumption or tie the decision to the Run's project; say in the generated order from which directory to submit.

findings.statement: SCN-ENF-041 requires three Run events, but REQ-ENF-004 does not say what guard_events[].paths holds for a path outside the project (run/1: POSIX path relative to root); an absolute temp path leaks the user dir into the committed Run.
findings.recommendation: Specify the recorded form (e.g. empty or a marker) and assert it in SCN-ENF-041.

findings.statement: The agent cannot know os.tmpdir() of guard: the generated file is byte-stable, macOS TMPDIR is not /tmp, Windows may give an 8.3 short path; the deny hint carries only a placeholder.
findings.recommendation: Make the deny reason/hint name the actual temp dir path and compare normalized (realpath) paths.

findings.statement: REQ-ENF-007 does not define --file missing/unreadable/empty, empty stdin, or the base of a relative --file, though --file becomes the main path.
findings.recommendation: Name code and hint for each (and whether data.received with bytes 0 is given); add to SCN-ENF-042.

findings.statement: Rolled up: (a) REQ-ENF-007 bytes of received envelope vs SCN-ENF-042 UTF-8 length differ on BOM/UTF-16, key sort order unstated; (b) REQ-VER-002 limitation 'in {out}' literal or substituted; (c) REQ-KRN-033 'the example envelope' while body has two; (d) REQ-KRN-033 adds 'deleted' beyond ADR-0042 p.5, hint ru (ADR) vs en (design); (e) INFO REQ-ENF-004 mode flags take words after positionals/'--', valued flag (-W error) leaves 'python -m pytest' unguarded; (f) INFO settings and frontmatter hooks both fire on subagent Write (duplicate events), main session may also write to temp (BL-83); (g) INFO temp envelope cleanup unstated.
findings.recommendation: Clarify each wording in the next Draft; INFO items need no spec change.
